name: GL_SEG_VAL_HIER_CF
description: GL_SEG_VAL_HIER_CF uses the structure of the FND_TREE_NODE_CF table as a template. It holds the relationship between various nodes in a given tree version in column-flattened manner for the accounting flexfield tree structure.
